title: Convert Tier 3 prescriptive choices to SHOULD + implementer rationale
description:
Companion epic to jmap-chat-spec-uy1m (Tier 2). Mark's override of the original "leave alone" verdict on the four Tier 3 findings.

Principle: where the spec currently states a normative choice with no explanation, the right shape is usually SHOULD + a sentence telling the implementer *why* that value/policy is recommended. This is a third path between:
- MUST (too rigid; ignores legitimate deployment variation)
- Silence (no guidance; produces divergent implementations that surprise users)

SHOULD + rationale gives implementations latitude, educates readers about the calibration or design intent, and produces convergent default behavior without prohibiting principled deviation.

Four items in scope:
- T3-1 (we5b... no, this epic): 10s client typing decay (main draft :935)
- T3-2: 3s server typing rate limit (main draft :931)
- T3-3: slow-mode exemption tied to manage_channels (main draft :427)
- T3-4: group-chat admin role hardcoding (main draft :442, :881)

Each child has its own bead with suggested rewording.

These can be done piecemeal; some pair (T3-1 + T3-2 are calibrated against each other and probably want a single commit).
